reviewers.scope: Data provenance, historical input roles, Q construction, FM cache identity, stage readiness

interpretations: M2 primary predicates use distance AND proximity to a group boundary.
Group center means the K-means arithmetic centroid, not a coordinate median or a medoid.
M2-A distance is to the nearest of all valid positively rated input movies.
M2-B distance is to the candidate movie's own unnormalized K-means centroid.
remaining_execution_gates: Exact implementation code review and source hash manifest
Source and cohort integrity, score and Q provenance checks
claim_limits: Neither recommendation method has been run or proven superior.
Historical development cohort is not a fresh final test.
Held-out-person-feature novelty is a proxy, not actual discovery satisfaction.
FM cache lookup does not establish end-to-end inference latency improvement.
